title: Multiple Linear Regression II Quiz
description: Ten multiple-choice questions on Chapter 4 categorical predictors and joint inference.

questions.question: Which statement best describes binary variables in this chapter?
options: A factor with c categories is represented with c-1 binary indicators when an intercept is present; the omitted level is the reference.
It estimates an unconditional correlation only
It removes all need for model assumptions
It applies only to time-series data
questions.explanation: The source explains that A factor with c categories is represented with c-1 binary indicators when an intercept is present; the omitted level is the reference. The correlation-only option is a tempting but incorrect simplification.
